### 2026-11-01: October 30th: PCB done

**3h**

October 30th: PCB done

Halloween so couldn't get too much work done and was kind of distracted. So I did initially did all the wiring but realized my 8 pin connector had to be replaced with a 8 pin male wire connector because the LCD screen I am using comes with a cable that is female wires. So wasted an hour but thats the part of designing!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/7fb1059fbe2957d01e08b70cafd7ff30cd9ede5ebac22c346d90663096fec201.png)

Then finally added PCB for everything and finished the overall PCB design. Added 2 mounting holes for M4.
